transcript.text: Alright, let's get this coordination huddle started. We've got the quarterly communications-equipment audit that has to be completed this Wednesday, in either the Comms Annex or the Admin Hall. I need to publish the final facility and schedule order, and the base access desk and facilities control room both need it before Tuesday's close of business. Before I put out that order, I want to hear from both of you -- signal officer, facilities officer -- are there any updates or issues affecting the audit I should know about? Facility availability, equipment status, scheduling conflicts, anything at all. Let's hear it.

transcript.text: Sir, I have an update. I confirmed with the audit team this morning that the audit requires exactly four uninterrupted hours and a dedicated UPS-backed circuit for the entire period. This requirement is in the team's technical checklist but has not yet been added to your planning slide, so you may not have had it when preparing the order.

transcript.text: Sir, I have a facilities update. I confirmed this morning that the Comms Annex's UPS circuit will be unavailable from 1000 to 1200 for a scheduled generator load test.
